about.title: About the App
about.subtitle: Vigilaro Care V6 Neo.
about.missionText: Helping families turn the home into a safe place. We start from something learned on the job: most household accidents do not happen by chance, they happen through neglect — and a hazard spotted in time never becomes an incident.
about.authorText: Vigilaro Care’s prevention content is written by Agnaldo Fontinele, a Brazilian-certified Occupational Safety Technician with over 30 years in the field — eight of them dedicated to occupational safety, in private industry and in the oil sector, and more than two decades in refinery and fuel transfer-and-storage terminal operations, where prevention is not a recommendation: it is a condition for operating.
about.authorMethod: The concepts that organise the app come from that practice — unsafe condition, near miss and inspection routine. It is industrial prevention methodology, translated to the home and to the language of the people who live in it.
about.authorBook: Editorial basis: “O Guia Completo para Prevenção de Acidentes em Casa — Prevenção 3D” (Cia do eBook, 1st edition, 2020 · ISBN 978-65-86755-67-1), by the same author.
about.authorScope: The app provides prevention guidance. It does not diagnose, does not prescribe treatment and does not replace medical, veterinary or emergency care.
about.resetMsg: Are you sure? This will delete ALL data. The app will return to its initial state.
about.madeWith: Made in Brazil, with method and care
about.copyright: 2026 Vigilaro Care LTDA. All rights reserved.
about.creditsIntro: The prevention content is original work. The public databases below support specific lookups — products, substances and plants — and are credited under their respective licences:
about.creditsOFF: Product data: Open Food Facts, an open collaborative database, under the ODbL licence.
about.creditsEPA: Toxicology data: EPA CompTox, from the United States Environmental Protection Agency.
about.creditsCiatox: Venomous animals, toxic plants and emergency numbers: Toxicological Information and Assistance Centres (CIATox) and official health sources.
about.creditsPhotos: Photographs: the author’s own collection, Pexels and Unsplash.
about.creditsIllustrations: Illustrations and pictograms: created with the help of artificial intelligence and reviewed by the author.
about.creditsMapas: Country borders, used to find the emergency number where you are: Natural Earth, public domain.

IntroSafetyMenuScreen.segurancaDomesticaNaoEAcidenteE: Home safety is no accident — it is planning. It is the set of measures taken to reduce risks and protect the physical well-being of the whole family. Many accidents happen where we should be safest: at home.
IntroSafetyMenuScreen.aMetodologia3dDefineAcoesPara: The 3D Methodology sets out actions for Daily, Dynamic and Durable prevention, turning the home into a safe refuge. To reduce household hazards, prevention and awareness are the keys. The vast majority of accidents do not happen by chance, but through neglect.
IntroSafetyMenuScreen.osQuaseAcidentesETambemOs: “Near misses”, and accidents without injury or damage, must not be ignored: they are “warnings” of what can — and probably will — happen if unsafe acts and conditions are ignored. Remember: sooner or later an accident happens when those “warnings” are ignored.

paisEmergencia.semLocalizacaoGenerico: Without location, Vigilaro cannot tell which country you are in and shows the general emergency number, 112.
paisEmergencia.fronteira: You are near a border. So as not to show another country's number, Vigilaro uses 112 — your phone routes the call to local emergency services.
paisEmergencia.desconhecido: We could not tell which country you are in. Call 112 — your phone routes the call to local emergency services in most countries.
paisEmergencia.semNumeroVerificado: You are in {{pais}}. Vigilaro does not have verified local numbers for this country yet: call 112 — your phone routes it to local emergency services in most countries — and check the local number as soon as you can.
paisEmergencia.outroPais: You are in {{pais}}: the emergency number here is {{numero}}. The numbers on this screen are already the local ones.
paisEmergencia.viagemTexto: With location on, Vigilaro recognizes the country you are in and shows its emergency number. Without it, the app shows the numbers of the country set on your phone. Abroad, if in doubt, call 112 — your phone routes the call to local emergency services in most countries. To work out the country, your position stays on the device.
paisEmergencia.semCiencia: Vigilaro can use the location you have already allowed to work out which country you are in and show its emergency number — including when you travel. Your position stays on the device; only the country is stored. For now, the numbers shown are for {{pais}}.
paisEmergencia.recusou: You chose not to use location to work out the country: the numbers shown are for {{pais}}, the country set on your phone.
paisEmergencia.porQueAtivar: With location on, Vigilaro works out which country you are in; your position stays on the device.

privacidade.paisTitulo: Find the country for emergency numbers
privacidade.paisTexto: Uses your location, only on the device, to show the emergency number of the country you are in. Only the country is stored. When off, the numbers follow the country set on your phone. Sending your location in an SOS does not depend on this.
privacidade.iaTexto: Sends the Scanner photo to OpenAI (US) and, for the personalized analysis, the age group, the home and the inspection results — without names and without any health information. When off, none of this leaves your phone and the rest of the app works as usual.

consentimentoIA.texto:
To create this analysis, Vigilaro sends to OpenAI (United States), through Vigilaro's server:

• the photo you choose, when you use the Scanner;
• the profile's age group, the type of home, its rooms, the city and the inspection results.

No names and no health information (conditions, medications, allergies) are sent. OpenAI does not use this data to train models and keeps it for up to 30 days only for abuse monitoring. You can withdraw this permission at any time under Privacy → Your choices. Without it, the rest of the app works as usual.
consentimentoIA.semPermissaoScanner: Photo analysis uses artificial intelligence and needs your permission. The photo did not leave your phone. You can allow it under Privacy → Your choices.
consentimentoIA.cartaoResumo: The personalized analysis is made by artificial intelligence and is only created with your permission.
